about.title: Why do you need ReplyFlow AI
about.text1: ReplyFlow AI is an intelligent service designed to automate customer responses in sales. It helps quickly generate professional replies to customer inquiries, saving managers' time.
about.text2: Our service uses artificial intelligence to instantly create high-quality responses tailored to specific situations. You get several answer options and choose the best one.
about.text3: ReplyFlow AI helps managers respond faster, sell more effectively, and not lose customers due to long waiting times for replies.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can AI respond instead of a manager?
faq.a1: AI generates responses, but the manager can always review or edit them before sending.
faq.q2: Is the service suitable for online stores?
faq.a2: Yes. The service is ideal for processing customer inquiries in chats and marketplaces.
faq.a3: CRM integration allows you to automatically save all generated responses in your CRM system (HubSpot, amoCRM, Pipedrive).
faq.q4: Are there limits on the number of generations?
faq.a4: Yes. Depending on the plan: Free — 10/day, Starter — 50/day, Professional — 150/day, Business — unlimited.
faq.a5: We use Groq (Llama 3.1, Llama 3.3), OpenRouter (DeepSeek) and HuggingFace (Mistral) for the best response quality.
faq.q6: Can I try it for free?
faq.a6: Yes. You get 3 free demo generations without registration. After registration — 10 generations per day on the Free plan.
faq.a7: API access is only available on the Business plan. You will be able to integrate our AI into your services.
faq.a8: Payment is currently in test mode. We will add Stripe and Liqpay soon.

extension.description: Chrome extension — generate responses directly in Telegram Web or Instagram Web
extension.install_step1: Download the archive and unzip it
extension.install_step2: Open Chrome → enter in address bar: chrome://extensions/
extension.install_step3: Enable 'Developer mode' (toggle in the upper right corner)
extension.install_step6: The extension will appear in the toolbar
extension.api_key_step1: Click the extension icon in the toolbar
extension.api_key_step2: Enter your API key (Profile → Integrations → Generate API Key)
extension.api_key_step3: Click Save — the extension is ready to use
extension.how_to_use_1: Select the customer's question with your mouse → a 'ReplyFlow AI' button will appear
extension.how_to_use_2: Click the button → get 3 response options
extension.how_to_use_3: Or right-click on the selected text → choose 'Generate reply with ReplyFlow AI'
extension.how_to_use_4: Or click the extension icon in the toolbar → paste the question manually
